name: Curse of the Juniper Tree
source:
Curse of the Juniper tree is a tale of two siblings, a cursed tree and an isolated village.

It is a short kinetic visual novel featuring 2d exploration. Walk around the snowy village and talk to its inhabitants!

Story is loosely based off the fairytale called The Juniper Tree by the Brothers Grimm in Grimm's Fairy Tales in 1812.

[From [url=https://tanaw.itch.io/curseofthejunipertree]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《杜松树的诅咒》讲述了两兄弟、一棵被诅咒的树和一个偏僻村庄的故事。

这是一部以二维探索为特色的短篇动态视觉小说。在白雪皑皑的村庄里漫步并与村里的居民交谈！

故事大致改编自格林兄弟于1812年创作的童话《杜松树》。

[来自[url=https://tanaw.itch.io/curseofthejunipertree]itch.io[/url]]
